About this page

Every course in one place: sessions to attend, deadlines from Canvas, and the material buried in the Canvas modules, each with a link. Pick the study period and your courses at the top. Day shows one day with what is due soon and the free time for group work, All deadlines is the flat list.

Tick boxes are yours alone. On claude.ai they follow your account, otherwise they stay in this browser. Green counts deadlines and tasks, blue counts material. The button mutes an item that is not for you: it stays visible, stops pulsing and leaves the counts.

MUSTgraded, required, a session you cannot miss, or what one of those depends on. Red stripe. NICEreadings, videos, recordings: helps, not required Canvas tracks this item (view, post, mark done, submit) pulse   course colours   working hours

Unofficial, made by a student. Canvas is always right when the two disagree.

Sessions come from the course schedule pages. expected marks a lecture placed by module order into a slot from the Homepage timetable, not yet named by the teacher. Minutes are rough estimates from page length and video count, or the course's own figure where it gives one. Times are Stockholm time. Icons: Phosphor (MIT).
